scientific_integrity: Analytic proof establishes the all-dimensional result; rational finite checks are only verification samples. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The estimate is sharp uniformly over dimensions, but lower and upper estimates need not coincide for a fixed dimension. Only the uniform product cube and maximum-coordinate Lipschitz seminorm are treated; comparison with all historical formulations is incomplete.
title: Sharp dimension-free Lipschitz amplification of affine least-squares projections on cubes
